__NOTOC__
= Potions =
'''Potions''' are consumable items in '''Prospecting''' that grant temporary stat boosts when used.  
They can be purchased from various merchants across the world.  

Each potion lasts for a limited time and provides effects such as increased '''Luck''', '''Capacity''', '''Strength''', '''Shake Speed''', and more.  

== Overview ==
Potions can be purchased from the following merchants:
* [[#Fortune River Town Alchemist|Fortune River Town Alchemist]] – basic Luck and Capacity potions  
* [[#Volcanic Sands Alchemist|Volcanic Sands Alchemist]] – powerful Luck and Strength potions  
* [[#Frostbitten Path Alchemist|Frostbitten Path Alchemist]] – more powerful Luck and Speed potions
* [[#Rotwood Swamp Alchemist|Rotwood Swamp Alchemist]] – even more powerful Luck potions
* [[#Astral Caverns Alchemist|Astral Caverns Alchemist]] - luck, strength, and size boost potions
* [[#Desert Alchemist|Desert Alchemist]] - luck, mod boost, and speed potions
* [[#Shard Merchant|Shard Merchant]] – potion focused on sell value  
* [[#Traveling Merchant|Traveling Merchant]] – rare and unique potions  

=== Usage ===
* Potions can be purchased "in bulk" by inputting the desired number.
** If you put in a larger number than the merchant's stock, it will say "out of stock" and no potions will be purchased.
* The potion(s) will go into your inventory (backpack) as a consumable item.
* To use a potion, select it in your inventory, then click/tap on the screen.
* When using the potion, if you have more than one, you can input the desired duration by selecting the number of potions to activate.
** Unlike the purchasing window, the duration window will not let you select more potions than what you have in your inventory.

== Trivia ==
* 🧪 Potions used to take effect immediately upon purchase, but have been changed into consumable items in your inventory.  
* 💫 Potion effects do not stack with the same potion type, but can combine across different potions.  
* 💎 Shard-exclusive potions are typically more powerful than cash-exclusive ones.  
* 🧭 Potions can be used anywhere and their timers persist even when moving between locations.   
* ⌛ Potion duration pauses when the player logs out.
